# JobAlertGroups.com — Comprehensive Entity & Knowledge Documentation

> JobAlertGroups.com is a publicly accessible directory indexing verified, active job alert communities across Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp. All listings undergo multi-gate algorithmic verification, regular link-health testing, and anti-scam pattern detection.

## Mission & Architecture

JobAlertGroups organizes public career channels into a clean, searchable index to protect job seekers from spam, fraudulent recruiters, and dead links. The directory is completely static, privacy-preserving, and neutral.

### Key Facts:
- **Primary Domain**: https://jobalertgroups.com/
- **Brand**: JobAlertHub / JobAlertGroups
- **Core Vertical**: Employment, Careers, Hiring Alerts, Internships
- **Verification Standard**: 12 Programmatic Quality Gates + Bi-Weekly Automated Link Health Checks
- **Policy**: Fact-first, zero-hallucination data. No fake ratings, no fake member counts, no sponsored endorsements.

---

## Supported Messaging Platforms

1. **Telegram Channels & Groups**:
   - URL Pattern: `https://t.me/<channel_or_group>`
   - Characteristics: Real-time broadcast alerts, notification channels, high-frequency hiring posts.
   - Index Page: https://jobalertgroups.com/platform/telegram/

2. **Discord Career Servers**:
   - URL Pattern: `https://discord.gg/<code>`
   - Characteristics: Two-way discussions, career advice, code reviews, hiring channels, community support.
   - Index Page: https://jobalertgroups.com/platform/discord/

3. **WhatsApp Community Groups**:
   - URL Pattern: `https://chat.whatsapp.com/<code>`
   - Characteristics: Fast regional alerts, mobile-first local job postings.
   - Index Page: https://jobalertgroups.com/platform/whatsapp/

## Trust, Ethics & Safety Framework

JobAlertGroups operates under a strict anti-fraud policy:
1. **Zero Advance Fees**: No community requiring payment for job application or interviews is listed.
2. **Task Scam Rejection**: Any group promoting "task-based earnings", "crypto deposits", or "guaranteed returns" is immediately banned.
3. **Official Reporting Linkage**: We direct users to official fraud reporting agencies (US FTC/IC3, UK Action Fraud, Australian Scamwatch, Canadian CAFC, Indian Cyber Crime Portal).
4. **Documentation**:
   - How We Verify: https://jobalertgroups.com/how-we-verify/
   - Safety Guide: https://jobalertgroups.com/safety/
   - Editorial Policy: https://jobalertgroups.com/editorial-policy/
